scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply mcstats-directory --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.seed:local: node scripts/seed-fake.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute mcstats --local --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.roster:local: node scripts/roster-sql.mjs 2 > .wrangler/roster.sql && wrangler d1 execute mcstats --local --file .wrangler/roster.sql
scripts.roster:remote: node scripts/roster-sql.mjs 2 > .wrangler/roster.sql && wrangler d1 execute mcstats --remote --file .wrangler/roster.sql
scripts.build:mod: cd mod && ./gradlew build --continue; cd .. && node scripts/mod-release.mjs
